title: Narada Vijaya
desc: Narada, a celestial being, is forced to descend to Earth and interact with humans. However, complications arise when he is mistaken for Vijay, a police officer.

title: Andhra King Taluka
desc: Sagar, a fan of the actor Surya Kumar, makes a life-altering sacrifice to fund his idol's milestone film. However, he jeopardises his own happiness and assets to ensure the production succeeds.

title: Kalki
desc: In a post-apocalyptic world, a group of people set out to save a woman pregnant with Lord Vishnu's 10th and final avatar, Kalki, from an evil supreme god-king, Yaskin.

title: Bhagavanth Kesari
desc: A former prisoner is adamant about training his adoptive daughter to join the Indian Army. However, his mission is interrupted by a conflict with a ruthless businessman.

title: Bhairathi Ranagal
desc: Bhairathi Ranagal ends up in jail after going against the law. However, when he is released, he strives to fight for the people of his village.

title: Sriramachandra
desc: Twins Srirama and Chandra are separated after their parents' divorce. When Srirama is killed by his greedy manager, he returns as a ghost and possesses his twin to exact revenge.
